description: This file defines a CameraPreview class that extends SurfaceView and implements SurfaceHolder.Callback to manage camera preview display, handle surface lifecycle events, and compute correct display orientation for camera preview in an Android app.

classes.name: CameraPreview
classes.description: A custom SurfaceView that manages camera preview display, including starting and stopping the preview and calculating necessary display orientation adjustments.

methods.name: CameraPreview
methods.description: Constructor for CameraPreview that initializes camera, camera info, and display orientation, and sets up the surface holder callback.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Called when the surface is created; sets the camera preview display and starts the preview.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Placeholder for handling surface destruction; currently no implementation.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface changes such as resizing or rotation; stops preview, adjusts display orientation, and restarts preview.

methods.name: calculatePreviewOrientation
methods.description: Calculates and returns the correct display orientation for the camera preview based on camera info and device rotation.
